title: Regional freeze & throttle windows + preflight slate for mixed-runtime rollouts
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Goal: Define and operationalize a coordinated launch calendar pattern that combines regional deployment freeze windows, throttling lanes, and a reusable preflight test slate for rollouts that touch multiple surfaces (runtime, console, API). This ticket creates the canonical schedule template and automation checklist teams will use for all mixed-runtime releases to reduce rollback risk and speed safe rollouts.

Scope:
- Create a regional freeze/throttle calendar schema (blackout windows, soft-throttle windows, safe-rollout windows) that maps to cloud regions and customer tiers.
- Define the preflight test slate (smoke, latency p95, critical evals, quota failover, KV-cache warmup) and owners for each test.
- Produce a release cadence template with timeboxed canary phases, escalation triggers, and automated gating (metrics + alerts).
- Implement a communication pattern (stakeholders, cadence of updates, escalation matrix) and a machine-readable JSON schedule that the Console and on-call tooling can consume.

Out of scope: automated enforcement in Dedicated private control planes (handled in follow-up ENG ticket), per-customer windows for Reserved Capacity customers (handled by account services).

Success criteria (measurable):
- A published calendar template + consumption spec (JSON schema) and Confluence page with runbook.
- Console can display schedule overlays for planned rollouts (mocked data) and alert teams when window conflicts occur.
- Preflight slate executed automatically in CI for the next three internal releases and gating prevented at least one high-risk rollout.
- Less than 2 emergency rollbacks caused by region/time-zone collision in next quarter for releases using the template.

Key stakeholders / owners:
- PM owner: Aisha Khatri
- Eng owner (runtime rollout): Liam Chen
- Console/UX owner: Priya Shah
- Reliability SRE reviewer: Mateo Alvarez

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Regional traffic patterns differ; a blanket throttle window may hurt key customers. Mitigation: add tier-aware exemptions and preflight traffic sampling.
- Risk: Teams ignore the template when timelines are tight. Mitigation: integrate schedule checks into PR and release gating dashboards.
- Risk: Automation false-positives block valid rollouts. Mitigation: provide a manual override audit flow and improve test signal quality.

Deliverables:
- JSON schedule schema + example files for NA/EU/APAC
- Confluence runbook with communication templates and templates for JIRA/Linear release tickets
- Console overlay mock and API contract for schedule consumption
- Preflight CI job definitions + sample dashboards
- Postmortem template for any blocked/rollback events

Timeline (high level):
- Week 1: Requirements & stakeholder alignment, finalize preflight slate (Feb 15–21)
- Week 2: Draft JSON schema + runbook; Console mockups (Feb 22–28)
- Week 3: Implement CI preflight job templates + example scheduled files (Mar 1–7)
- Week 4: Integrate schedule display into Console mock and run one dry-run release (Mar 8–14)
- Buffer + polish / release to cross-team (Mar 15–31)
